item.title: Tributes paid to Rod Holmes
item.description: Former colleagues of the man who spearheaded Liverpool ONE’s delivery have been united in saluting “a brilliant guy who empowered a city,” following his death last week. The post Tributes paid to Rod Holmes appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Peel plans 500 homes, 490,000 sq ft industrial in Wigan
item.description: Known as Gibfield Park, the major mixed-use scheme would be constructed on 173 acres between Atherton and Westhoughton. The post Peel plans 500 homes, 490,000 sq ft industrial in Wigan appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Wirral success for Aldi and Caldy
item.description: The European grocery group will develop a site at Champion Business Park, Upton, while the sports club can start working on the redevelopment of its clubhouse. The post Wirral success for Aldi and Caldy appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Acclaimed architect Desmond Williams dies at 93
item.description: The founder of Ellis Williams Architects has passed away, leaving behind a legacy of work that includes four grade two-listed churches. The post Acclaimed architect Desmond Williams dies at 93 appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: US hedge fund acquires Sale’s Stanley Square
item.description: Altered Space has disposed of the 160,000 sq ft retail and leisure complex to Magnetar, which has added the asset to its varied portfolio for an undisclosed sum. The post US hedge fund acquires Sale’s Stanley Square appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: The Great North shoots its Olympics shot
item.description: Mayors across the North of England are pushing for a 2036 or 2040 Games bid from the UK government, pitching the region as the host location in an effort to boost regeneration. The post The Great North shoots its Olympics shot appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Wingstop signs at Manchester Arndale
item.description: The fast-growing chicken brand has agreed terms on a five-year lease, taking the 5,928 sq ft former Yo Sushi unit. The post Wingstop signs at Manchester Arndale appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Lancaster County prepares £57m SEND boost
item.description: Proposals for two new schools, the expansion of four others, and the development of five specialist units for mainstream secondary schools were given an initial green light by the county council, with consultations to begin in March and April. The post Lancaster County prepares £57m SEND boost appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Work starts on Extra MSA’s Warrington services
item.description: Both Glencar, responsible for the facilities building, and highways contractor Bethell are on site at the development off Junction 11 of the M62. The post Work starts on Extra MSA’s Warrington services appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Gleeson given Preston go-ahead
item.description: An 18-acre plot off Bartle Lane can be redeveloped into 108 homes following city council approval. The post Gleeson given Preston go-ahead appeared first on Place North West.
